evaluators.stagewise: scripts/run_layerwise_profile.py convex_probe: per-coordinate standardization (train mean/std, floor 1e-6), multinomial logistic regression from zeros, LBFGS max_iter 200 history 10 strong_wolfe, weight penalty 1e-4 * ||W||^2, fit on all 50000 train images (deterministic transform), scored on 10000 test; profile_version layerwise_profile_20260823_v1 (gate units) / baseline_layerwise_v1 (baselines, same function imported); convex_probe md5 fc9e0f8b16a10876c67b4882a5f159eb identical from commit 8637c7e (2026-08-23) to ae02ffe
evaluators.sgd_probe: fmca_av/probe_module.LinearProbe: frozen backbone, linear classifier, SGD lr 0.1 momentum 0.9 wd 0, cosine over 100 epochs, train transform crop+flip; fit on 45000 = randperm(50000, unit seed)[5000:], val 5000 logged only (no checkpointing, no selection), scored on 10000 test

ema_in_validation: HierarchyCertificateModule._shared_step calls _variant_loss for both train and val; the EMA endpoint buffer update (ema_c_dir.mul_(m).add_(c_dir,1-m)) is unconditional, so validation batches (every 10 epochs) and the Lightning sanity-check batches update it. Introduced c60f532 (2026-08-19); unchanged through ae02ffe; identical for the Aug-20/21 archived ridge units and the 14-Sep replications.
